capabilities: Blend the accent color through an ordered palette
Choose a color space for blending (OKLCH, HSL, RGB)
Add, reorder and remove palette colors
Derive the current color from the clock for consistency across devices
extras: Overrides the accent color only while enabled and does not change the Accent color setting; disabling the plugin restores your own color. Interface available in English and Korean.
problem: Obsidian's accent color is fixed, so there is no way to have links, tags and buttons shift through several colors over time.
summary: Plugin that gradually blends Obsidian's accent color through a palette of your choice, cycling back to the first color after the last.
